question: A pipe can fill a tank in 27 hours. Another pipe can empty the filled tank in 28 hours. If both the pipes are opened simultaneously, then the time (in hours) in which the tank will be one-fourth filled, is:
solution:
**Given:**

Pipe A fills tank = 27 hrs

Pipe B empties tank = 28 hrs

Required = 1/4 part filled

**Formula used:**

Total work = LCM(27,28) units = 756 units

Rate = units/hr

**Calculation:**

⇒ Work = 756 units

⇒ A rate = 756 ÷ 27 = 28 units/hr

⇒ B rate = 756 ÷ 28 = 27 units/hr

⇒ Net rate = 28 - 27 = 1 unit/hr

⇒ Work required = (1/4) × 756 = 189 units

⇒ Time = 189 ÷ 1 = 189 hrs

**∴ Tank will be 1/4 filled in 189 hrs.**
